introduction: New York’s earned income credit is claimed on the state income-tax return. It is linked to the same-year federal EITC.
description: New York’s earned income credit is claimed on the state income-tax return. It is linked to the same-year federal EITC.

sections.who: You must qualify for and claim federal EITC and meet identification rules. The noncustodial-parent credit cannot also be claimed.
sections.get: The credit is generally30% of allowable federal EITC, reduced by household credit. Refundability differs by residency.
sections.docs:
• Federal return and EITC calculation.
  • Valid Social Security numbers for required people.
  • Earned-income records, including self-employment books.
sections.apply:
1. Establish federal eligibility

    Complete the federal return.

  2. Complete IT-215

    Use Tax Department guidance and correct-year instructions.

  3. File state taxes

    Include the credit form and retain supporting records.
sections.after: Keep business evidence if self-employed; the department can request it.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using New York earned income credit. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
